name: Horse Gram Rasam
ingredients: ¼ cup (50 g) horse gram (kulthi), soaked overnight
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds, ½ tsp cumin seeds, 6 curry leaves, 2 garlic cloves, 1 dried chilli
¼ tsp turmeric and pinch of hing
steps: Pressure-cook the horse gram with 2 cups water for 6 whistles until soft. Mash lightly and keep the cooking water.
Boil the tomatoes with the tamarind, rasam powder, turmeric and salt for 6 minutes.
Add the horse gram and its water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Heat the oil and crackle the mustard and cumin; add curry leaves, garlic, chilli and hing, then pour over the rasam.
note: A traditional South Indian protein-rich broth; horse gram is among the highest-protein pulses.
